limitations: Three sequential identical questions, not a load/quality/HA benchmark.
First request is not a controlled cold disk/page-cache measurement.
All outputs reached the 64-token cap; two lacked citations.
Read-only incumbent probe latency is not customer traffic or a production SLO.
No real GPU/HBM, remote KV transfer, persisted traces or delivered alerts.
Same-volume backup only; no off-host restore or live pause/resume test.
No unattended monitoring or public inference enabled.
